## Concise image prompts and a reliable image model

- Work OS `5de265cf-db4e-48b6-841c-895ff49222a9`; worktree
  `/home/maigreeks/projects/.worktrees/launchloom-image-prompt`, base
  `df85c2a6`.
- Root cause of the rejection storm: the image model was typesetting prompt
  text. The production prompt for the architecture brief produced a
  document titled "Analyze the Request"; a 145-character photo prompt still
  produced a browser screenshot on one trial. Re-running the exact prompt that
  had produced a clean interior later produced clean images again, so the
  generator is stochastic, not the reviewer.
- Two prompt bugs: the family brief was looked up by `referenceDna.familyId`
  (the dossier id), so every site fell back to generic text, and the prompt
  carried layout/typography cues ("oversized wordmark") that invited lettering.
  The composer now uses the compiled family, a short family scene noun, the
  business kind, and strips typography terms. Prompts are now about 150-250
  characters, noun-first, with constraints last.
- Model comparison on the same architecture prompt: minimax/image-01 approved
  1/3; `fal-ai/flux/dev` 2/2; `fal-ai/bytedance/seedream/v4/text-to-image` 2/2
  with the most relevant interiors. Default switched to Seedream v4; the
  `FAL_IMAGE_MODEL` override is unchanged.
- Tests: 44 contextual-asset tests pass after updating the prompt contract.
  Type check recorded separately.
- Blocker: fal.ai returned HTTP 403 "User is locked. Reason: Exhausted
  balance." Further image generation and calibration are blocked until the
  account is topped up.

### Workers AI image provider

- Cloudflare Workers AI is now the default image provider:
  `IMAGE_PROVIDER=workers-ai`, model `@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-1-schnell`.
  `scripts/workers-ai-image.mjs` posts the prompt, decodes the base64 PNG, and
  returns bytes directly so the normalizer and reviewer stay shared. FAL
  remains selectable with `IMAGE_PROVIDER=fal`.
- The existing `launchloom-github-actions` token was granted Account Workers AI
  Read in the dashboard, so its stored value did not need to be copied or
  reissued. That token expires 2026-12-03 and needs rotation before then.
- Verified end to end on the real architecture brief: one hero generated
  through Workers AI, normalized to WebP, reviewed, and approved
  (`reviewStats` approved 1). The image is a text-free architectural hall.
- Tests: 48 passed across Workers AI and contextual-asset suites; type check
  recorded separately. This removes the fal.ai balance blocker.
